name: btn-hover-down

frames.best_why: The hard blue offset shadow is fully visible under the resting button, which is the state that defines the look.

tagline: Blue Contact me button with a hard offset shadow that flattens on hover.
summary: A rounded-rectangle Contact me button in a navy gradient with a solid blue shadow set behind its lower-right edge. On hover the button shifts into the shadow and the shadow disappears, so it looks pressed.
appearance: A wide rounded-rectangle button in a navy-to-blue gradient with a bright blue outline and white Contact me text. A solid blue shadow block sits directly behind it, offset a few pixels right and down.
behaviour: On hover the button slides right and down into the shadow's place while the shadow shrinks away, so the two become one flat slab. Moving off slides them back apart.
search_phrases: blue contact button with drop shadow
button that moves into its shadow
use_when: A primary button needs a chunky, physical feel and a clear pressed response on hover.
avoid_when: The hard shadow and fixed blue palette look heavy on light minimal pages, and the offset needs spare space.
customise: The label, gradient, border and shadow colours and offsets are hardcoded classes; it accepts no props.
weight_why: One button, one CSS shadow and a short transform transition.

a11y.note: It is a real button with visible text and a native focus ring, but the pressed shadow effect fires on hover only.

polish_why: Crisp hard shadow and a satisfying click-like hover; simple but well executed.
